purpose: Durable CarUp-owned URLs for assets referenced by outbound Email. Email lives in inboxes for years; a build-hashed application asset, a preview URL or a third-party placeholder host does not.
notes: null means the asset does not exist and must not be referenced. No CarUp logo artwork exists anywhere in the repository or its history, and favicon.svg is a 24x24 site icon, not a logo.
The text wordmark is the approved Email v1 identity until artwork is separately approved.
This file exists so the namespace is a real, certifiable static object without inventing artwork to fill it.
